messages.english: Embrapa: Banco de Dados de Solos do Brasil (BDSolos) / Redape
Brazil national morphological and analytical soil-profile catalogue

The official Redape catalogue entry describes national morphological and analytical soil-profile records (BDSolos); this documentation was read without downloading raw datasets or analyzing individual farm soils.
Catalogue displays an Embrapa CC BY-NC 4.0 label; commercial reuse clearance, file access, API authentication, measurement units, and update cadence remain unverified.
